description:
## Finding

Workspace-wide: zero of 32 crates declare `[package.metadata.docs.rs]`
or use `#[cfg_attr(docsrs, doc(cfg(feature = "...")))]` annotations
on feature-gated public items.

Verified absent via:
`grep -rn 'package.metadata.docs.rs\|cfg_attr(docsrs' --include=Cargo.toml --include=*.rs` returns zero hits workspace-wide.

## Impact

Every extension-server crate gates its reference `MemoryBackend` impl
behind `feature = "memory"`. Default features are empty. Consequence:
docs.rs builds with default features → reference impls are invisible
on rendered docs. The kit's own lib.rs doc strings point readers at
the gated module, so the published docs.rs page contradicts the
crate's own pointer.

## Scope

All 32 workspace crates. The extension-server crates (mail, chat,
calendars, tasks, contacts, filenode, sharing, metadata) feel this
most because they all gate `memory::MemoryBackend`.

## Fix shape

Per crate Cargo.toml:
```toml
[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]
```

Per crate src/lib.rs (and any gated submodule):
```rust
#[cfg(feature = "memory")]
#[cfg_attr(docsrs, doc(cfg(feature = "memory")))]
pub mod memory;
```

## Workspace propagation rule

Per workspace AGENTS.md Canonical Templates: change jmap-mail-server
(canonical extension-server template) first, then propagate to all
8 extension-server siblings + foundation crates in same pass.
jmap-types and the type-only siblings need only the Cargo.toml block
(they have no feature gates today).

## Provenance

Filed via JMAP-x2gd.61 (chat-server-local symptom of the workspace-
wide gap). Bead .61 closed with pointer to this epic.
title: (EPIC) Workspace-wide docs.rs config + #[cfg_attr(docsrs)] gate annotations
